description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for an observatory, planetarium, science museum, space-tourism or any dark, wonder-led venue, ready to make your own. Home, Sky Tonight, Visit and Tickets, Learn, About and Contact share one deep-space identity: violet-black backgrounds, a warm amber accent, Sora headings and glowing hairline cards. A stats-gradient hero, a what-you-might-see feature grid, a bento of evening options, a single guest testimonial, a scrolling monthly sky guide, a naked-eye versus telescope comparison, three-tier tickets, a what-to-bring checklist, a group-booking form, learning programmes, an astronomer team grid, a story timeline and a full-bleed quote are all in place.
